description: Stop RepuTend watching your business's reviews on one review platform (Trustpilot or G2). The reviews it read there and their screening results are kept, and adding the same profile again later starts from them. A business keeps at least one profile: to stop tracking the business, remove the business instead, and to stop RepuTend altogether, the owner cancels the subscription. Refused while the platform has open cases. What a person may say: "stop watching our G2 reviews".

business.description: The business to act on, by its domain (such as example.com), one of those list_businesses shows. Needed only when your accounts track more than one business.

name: remove_profile
title: Remove a review platform profile
